title: Arize AZ 8433 DT (NSIC Rc 688H) Hybrid Rice: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Arize AZ 8433 DT (NSIC Rc 688H) Rice: Yield and Maturity
metaDescription: Arize AZ 8433 DT is NSIC Rc 688H, a hybrid rice for irrigated lowland: about 114 days and 8 tonnes per hectare on average. See its ratings.
excerpt: NSIC Rc 688H is a hybrid rice variety for irrigated lowland, sold as Arize AZ 8433 DT or AZ 8433 DT and known locally as Mestiso 119. The NSIC approved it in 2022. Bayer bred it. It matures in about 114 days and averages 8 tonnes per hectare, with a top yield of 9.8 tonnes in trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Arize AZ 8433 DT or AZ 8433 DT, or rice variety 688H, this is the one. Compare it with the other varieties in our [rice variety finder](/rice-varieties) before you buy seed. Also read our guide to [rice varieties in the Philippines](/crops/rice-varieties-philippines) for how inbreds, hybrids and special rice differ.

items: **Yield:** 8 tonnes per hectare on average, or about 159 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 9.8 tonnes.
**Holds up against:** rice blast, stem borer.
**Watch out for:** tungro, green leafhopper, brown planthopper.
**Cooked rice:** intermediate amylose, so soft but not sticky.

blocks.caption: Key facts of NSIC Rc 688H (t/ha means tonnes per hectare)

blocks.text: How much does NSIC Rc 688H yield?

On average it gives 8 tonnes per hectare. That is about 159 cavans of 50 kilograms of palay. It sits above the average of the 180 irrigated lowland hybrids on the list, which is 6.9 tonnes. But the top yield, 9.8 tonnes, came from a trial with good water, seed and care. So plan your costs on the average, then work toward the top with the habits in our guide to [raising rice yield per hectare](/blog/increase-rice-yield-per-hectare).
How many days does it take to mature?

It takes about 114 days from sowing to harvest. Varieties of 100 to 120 days count as short duration and 120 to 140 days as medium, so this one counts as short duration. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains turn golden yellow. Because the day count drives every task, anee.io counts it for you from each lot's own planting day, with the [growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: So scout early for [tungro](/diseases/rice-tungro), [green leafhopper](/pests/green-leafhopper), [brown planthopper](/pests/brown-planthopper). When you see the first signs, check the guide before you spray, because the right timing saves more than an extra dose. If you are not sure what you see, our [pest and disease finders](/features/pest-and-disease-finders) help you name it from the damage.

Amylose decides how rice cooks. With intermediate amylose, expect rice that is soft but not sticky. In fact, Filipino taste has moved from high to intermediate and low amylose rice, because people want it softer. Head rice is the share of whole grains after milling. So a higher number means fewer broken grains and a better price at the mill.

items: **Days to harvest:** 114 to 120 days after sowing.
**How it is planted:** Direct seeded or transplanted.
**Seed:** 21 to 24 kg per hectare direct seeded, 15 kg transplanted.
About 121 cm tall, with 12 to 16 productive tillers.
Medium slender grain, with a milling recovery of 69 percent and head rice of 53.5 percent.
Cooks slightly aromatic, moderately soft and a little sticky.
Dual trait: bred to tolerate bacterial leaf blight and brown planthopper, the first such hybrid Bayer sells in the Philippines.
Planthoppers settle on other plants first and hopperburn shows later, so Bayer puts the spray threshold at 5 to 7 hoppers per tiller instead of 1.

blocks.text: These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual variety on the same ground.

It suits irrigated lowland, where you control the water. Level the field well so the water stands evenly, and plant together with the farms around you, so pests cannot move from field to field. Our guide to [rice land preparation](/land-preparation/rice-land-preparation) shows each step. For the right month in your province, see [the best time to plant rice](/blog/best-time-to-plant-rice-philippines).

items.q: Is Arize AZ 8433 DT the same as NSIC Rc 688H?
items.a: Yes. Arize AZ 8433 DT is the name it is sold under, and NSIC Rc 688H is its registration with the National Seed Industry Council, where its local name is Mestiso 119. The numbers on this page are for NSIC Rc 688H.

items.q: What is the local name of NSIC Rc 688H?
items.a: It is known as Mestiso 119. Seed sellers and agriculturists use both names, so ask for either one.

items.q: How many days does NSIC Rc 688H take to harvest?
items.a: About 114 days after sowing. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains are golden yellow.

items.q: What is the average yield of NSIC Rc 688H?
items.a: It averages 8 tonnes per hectare, about 159 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 9.8 tonnes. Your own yield depends on water, seed, fertilizer and timing.
Yes. So buy new seed each season, because seed saved from a hybrid crop does not grow true and yields less.

items.q: What should I watch for when I plant it?
items.a: In trials it was weak against tungro, green leafhopper, brown planthopper. So scout from the early weeks and act at the first signs.
